name: OMB M-26-15: Execution of the Migration to Post-Quantum Cryptography
update_frequency: One-time implementation memorandum with follow-up plans
known_limitations: The memorandum directs non-national-security federal systems and defines plan content and deadlines; it does not expose completed agency inventories, submitted migration plans, funding, vendor delivery, procurement outcomes, or migration completion.
jurisdiction: United States federal executive branch, excluding national security systems
automation_notes: Track agency migration plans, GSA identity and access work, CISA product-category guidance, NIST IR 8547 alignment, modernization decisions, and disclosed implementation milestones.
notes: Phase 55B implementation record. OMB M-26-15, dated June 24, 2026, requires a prioritized federal PQC migration, agency plans within 120 days, risk-based prioritization, governance, modernization, vendor-readiness work, and an objective of mitigating as much quantum risk as feasible by December 31, 2030.
